source: RFC 0007 §5.9 (RFC 0013 B4, the copies of a document)
statement: `bootstrap`, forced or not, publishes the platform tenant's document with its binding added and everything else the document holds kept: its policies, its other bindings, its rate limits and its roles. Only the header (revision, publishedAt, provenance) and the bindings change, so a migration that converts 7.x roles into that document and then bootstraps does not lose them.
guards: migrate:BootstrapKeepsDocumentTest#bootstrap adds its binding and keeps the rest of the document
